remarks:
This is a fantastic opportunity, and with seller financing available, to own one of the most prestigious condos in the city of Buffalo! Live with the best views in the city in this bright, modern condo! Sweeping panoramic views through floor-to-ceiling glass, giving golden sunsets by day, glittering city lights by night. One of the only condos in the building with a terrace. Step straight from the sunroom onto your own outdoor space, perfect for alfresco dinners, morning coffee, or just getting some fresh air. On nice days it gives you an easy indoor-outdoor flow that's hard to find. Inside, everything's been updated: fresh paint, new luxury vinyl flooring, updated electrical, and a kitchen with custom finishes and granite counters. The open layout makes everyday living and entertaining easy. The primary bedroom has an updated full ensuite bath and a generous walk-in closet. The second bedroom features a full wall of built-in cabinets with lighting and is currently set up as an office. The guest bath is freshly updated too. In-unit laundry, and one underground parking spot included.
Residents also enjoy a newly updated private gym and sauna — available to everyone who lives here.
This is a highly sought-after, luxurious end unit. Come see what it's like to call it home.
